verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a standalone Tax Calculations API that calculates tax from product type, customer location, and business or ship-from location, and it can return IP-geolocated estimates before the customer enters an address. That points to checkout-time use, and one hands-on user reports calculation based on the customer's full address. Missing for 10: any evidence of address-level (rooftop) accuracy rather than ZIP-level approximation, documented latency or performance figures suitable for checkout, and independent corroboration of jurisdiction-precise US rates.
